source.value: Rippers Unmasked — Core Rulebook v1.1 (Hope, heroic spell p.236)

summary.value: You rekindle the flames of courage and hope within a defeated hero.

system.description: You rekindle the flames of courage and hope within a defeated hero. Choose a Player Character who Surrendered but is still narratively present on the scene: that Player Character immediately regains consciousness and recovers an amount of Hit Points equal to their Crisis score. ... A Player Character may only be affected by this spell once per scene. ...
